heading: Catalogue versions
intro: Versions organise libraries, sections and document selections for offline exports. Editing a version does not publish it to Oasis.
no_versions: No catalogue versions yet. Create one to organise an offline export.
start_heading: Open a version to explore its libraries
start_help: Use Open above to browse libraries and sections, or create a new version.
libraries_help: Open a library to view its sections and documents.
folder_help: Open a section to browse further, or manage the documents here.
no_libraries: No libraries in this version yet. Add a library to get started.
no_sections: No sections here yet. You can add one to group documents.
membership_help: Removing a document here keeps its original file in the manager. Use the main catalogue to edit or delete the document itself.
no_documents: No documents here yet. Add existing documents from the catalogue below.
picker_help: Select available catalogue documents, then add them to this location. To use a document again in this version, enable “Duplicatable” in its document details.
modules_help: Modules are ZIP packages for the exported offline library. They are separate from your PDF documents.
no_modules: No modules added to this version.
action_failed: Could not complete the action. Your current view is still available; please try again.
